reopened_reason: EW-RS-039–041 expose sparse value supports, reject a broad simple-bilinear summary, and localize the remaining common interaction information to residual topology plus release timing.

new_assertions.body: Two-dimensional target rank does not imply a two-feature formula in an arbitrary coordinate gauge; canonical fitted supports can be sparse yet geometry-dependent.
Rank phase and component topology are separable pressures: R3 removes most 6x3 error in the simple bank, but exact rank cannot repair missing topology on either 6x3 or 4x4.
Frontier-relative release timing is structurally load-bearing inside residual incidence; 4x4 distinguishes exact delayed depths beyond delay parity and 0/1/2+ bucketing.
The coarsest tested scalar interaction coordinate is geometry-dependent: topology alone on 5x3, topology+delay parity on 6x3, full relative-delay incidence on 4x4.
A universal compact law should seek a release-semantic quotient shared by these geometry-specific minimal labels rather than selecting arbitrary fitted pair IDs.
